summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bible module (Biblia na Vitabu vya Dini). All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend Bible view tested successfully on mobile PWA - book/chapter/verse navigation and audio buttons working. Admin page requires Google auth (not tested via UI).

minor.issue: Text index creation was silently failing, causing 500 errors. FIXED by adding regex fallback.

passed_tests: GET /api/bible/stats - returns Bible data statistics (26 books, 7853 verses)
GET /api/bible/books - returns list of Bible books with localized names
GET /api/bible/books/{book}/chapters - returns chapters for a book
GET /api/bible/books/{book}/chapters/{chapter} - returns verses with text and references
POST /api/bible/tts/verse - generates TTS audio for a verse (OpenAI via Emergent)
GET /api/bible/snippets - returns active snippets for users
GET /api/admin/bible/snippets - returns all snippets for admin
POST /api/admin/bible/snippets - creates Bible snippet with TTS audio
GET /api/bible/snippets/{id} - returns snippet with audio_base64 data
GET /api/admin/bible/analytics - returns listening analytics (total_listens, popular_books, listening_times, daily_trend)
GET /api/bible/search - searches Bible text (regex fallback working)
GET /api/bible/passage/{book}/{chapter}/{start}/{end} - returns passage with combined text
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Bible data initialized with 26 books and 7853 verses (Swahili New Testament)
✓ TTS integration with OpenAI via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY working correctly

✓ Verse view shows audio buttons for each verse
✓ Admin page protected with role-based permissions (content_moderation, platform_settings)
